narrative.overview: Stories use a Read mode; discovery combines content-led persuasion with browsing; creation, checkout, Activity, Profile, review and reports use Operate. Personality comes from photographs, Newsreader story typography, ultramarine actions and precise rules, rather than repeated slogans, decorative labels or nested panels.
keyCharacteristics: Real campaign photography and selective editorial typography.
Ultramarine actions on warm paper, with quiet structural separators.
Compact utilities, persistent context and explicit financial provenance.
Native safe areas, scalable text and touch targets of at least 48dp.

rules.name: The Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use the stronger outline token for input boundaries. The pale separator belongs to decorative rules and containers. Focus uses primary; errors use error.

rules.name: The Task Rule
rules.body: Reserve editorial display type for reading and selected discovery moments. Payment, editing, account and reporting controls use functional type.

dos: Do preserve authored story structure, public evidence and mandatory funding disclosures.
Do reserve dock and tab space so essential content remains reachable.
Do pair monetary and delivery figures with truthful estimated or simulated provenance.
Do verify Android composition at 360, 393 and 411 logical pixels and font scale 1.3.
donts: Don't use oversized editorial headings on utility screens.
Don't replace campaign photography with unrelated decorative illustrations.
Don't add repeated slogans, nested panels or labels without a useful purpose.
Don't treat screenshot review as physical-device, screen-reader or human-usability certification.
